title: After El Mencho's death, what lies ahead for Mexico’s Jalisco New Generation Cartel?
summary: The killing of Nemesio "El Mencho" Oseguera Cervantes, leader of the powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel (CJNG), marked a turning point in Mexico’s long war against organised crime. But after his death triggered unrest across the country this week, fears are mounting that internal rivalries and territorial battles could trigger more violence.
